ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues from familiar rock musicians fits my recent Clapton and Hendrix interests; I would choose this today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country direction appeals after Blown Away, but I am only choosing a couple of albums today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Santana IV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Guitar-led rock sounds appealing, though blues is my stronger interest right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues and roots-oriented music rather than contemporary vocal pop today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The familiar country-rock sound fits, but a greatest-hits collection is less tempting than exploring another album.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Beatles; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock interests me, but this title alone gives me little reason to prioritize it today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Magical Mystery Tour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its psychedelic pop direction is less suited to my current blues and roots mood.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy country sound could suit me, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band Deluxe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently interested in a deluxe edition of psychedelic pop.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Johnny Winter's blues guitar is a strong match for my recent listening; I would choose this too.
